scripts.dev: concurrently -n remix,jobs,dspy,privacy -c blue,yellow,magenta,green "pnpm --filter @handover/remix dev" "pnpm --filter @handover/remix worker:watch" "pnpm dev:dspy" "pnpm dev:privacy"
scripts.dev:dspy: sh -lc 'cd apps/worker && set -a && . ../../.env && set +a && uv run python -m uvicorn handover_prod.app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload'
scripts.dev:privacy: test -f .env.local-privacy || { echo 'Copy .env.local-privacy.example to .env.local-privacy first.' >&2; exit 1; }; env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" TMPDIR="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" LOCAL_PRIVACY_ENV_FILE="$PWD/.env.local-privacy" LOCAL_PRIVACY_APP_DIR="$PWD/apps/local-privacy" sh -c 'set -a; . "$LOCAL_PRIVACY_ENV_FILE"; set +a; cd "$LOCAL_PRIVACY_APP_DIR"; export PATH="$LOCAL_PRIVACY_APP_DIR/.venv/bin:$PATH"; exec .venv/bin/handover-local-privacy'
